penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Primary buyers are healthcare and legal professionals; HIPAA compliance for healthcare document transmission and legal liability for fax delivery failures add meaningful regulatory risk and support complexity.

rationale: The buyer exists — legal/healthcare SMB admins who pay eFax or RingCentral — but the regulated_industry penalty is material because any healthcare document transmitted by fax must meet HIPAA standards, which requires BAAs and audit logging that a simple Claude + Stripe setup cannot provide out-of-the-box. Even setting regulation aside, the fax-sending core relies on third-party telephony APIs (Twilio, Fax.to) that require account setup, per-page costs, and failure-handling logic; operational autonomy is limited by fax delivery failures that need human review. At 4.0 total, this falls below the validate threshold.
solution_plan: This would be an 'Email-to-Fax Router' micro-service: an email address the customer controls forwards to this service, which uses a fax API (e.g. Twilio Programmable Fax or Interfax) to send the attachment to a fixed fax number, then logs confirmation. BUILD: technically feasible with a webhook receiver + Twilio Fax API + Claude for error triage, and a simple admin dashboard; a developer would be needed for the telephony integration. SELL: legal ops and healthcare admin communities; but the regulated nature means prospects will immediately ask about HIPAA compliance, BAAs, and audit trails — questions that are hard to answer cheaply. MAINTAIN: fax delivery failures, bounce handling, and regulatory audit requests add recurring human-judgement work. Honest verdict: the regulated-industry constraint and the need for real telephony infrastructure make this harder than it looks; drop unless you can secure a HIPAA-compliant fax API partner and legal review.
notes: Total 4.0 falls below min_total_to_validate (5.5). Primary driver: regulated_industry penalty (-1.5) plus moderate operational_autonomy limited by fax delivery failure handling and HIPAA requirements.
